Domestic worker rights in the UAE

RightEntitlement
Gratuity14 days of basic wage per year after one year of service (ministry announcement)
Annual leave30 paid days a year, paid in advance; 2 days per month between 6 months and a year; a ticket every two years
Sick leave30 days a year: 15 on full pay, then 15 on half pay
RestAt least 12 hours a day, 8 of them consecutive, and a paid weekly day off
ProbationUp to 6 months
Final duesWithin 10 days of the contract ending

Example: basic wage AED 1,500 (daily 50), 3 years and 4 months of service and 10 unused leave days: gratuity 50 × 14 × 3.33 = 2,333.33 plus leave pay 500, a total of AED 2,833.33, plus the return ticket.

Frequently asked questions

How much gratuity does a maid get in the UAE?

The rate applied is the one announced by the Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation: 14 days of basic wage for each year of service for workers who complete one year or more, with part years pro rata. Decree-Law 9 of 2022 leaves the details to a Cabinet decision, so check the ministry's calculator at settlement.

When is a domestic worker's gratuity lost?

When the contract ends because the worker stopped working without a lawful reason, according to the ministry. The contract may be ended if the worker is absent without excuse for more than 10 consecutive days or 15 intermittent days in a year.

How much annual leave does a domestic worker get in the UAE?

30 days of paid leave a year, paid before the leave starts. For service between 6 months and a year, 2 days per month. The employer pays a return ticket every two years and pays cash for unused leave when the contract ends.

When must a domestic worker's dues be paid?

Within 10 days of the end of the contract. Monthly wages must be paid within 10 days of their due date.

How much does the recruitment agency refund?

The agency refunds part of the recruitment cost in proportion to the months left on the contract: (cost ÷ contract months) × remaining months, within two weeks. It refunds the full cost if this happens in the first month or the worker is found medically unfit during probation. Direct hires are not covered.
